_note: P12.1 shot grammar (plan-cinematic section 1). Each shot type: size, lens range in mm, elevation range in degrees, length range in real seconds, default ease and move limits. Ranges are [min, max]. Source 'plan-cinematic section 1' is the plan table; 'starting guess' means the plan gave no number and this is a first estimate. Data/camera.json keeps the gameplay cameras and is not used here.

lensMm.why: Lens range for this shot type.

elevation.why: Camera elevation range in degrees above the subject center.

lengthSeconds.why: Shot length range in real seconds.

maxAzimuthSwing.source: starting guess, owner to tune by feel
maxAzimuthSwing.why: Largest azimuth change from start to end of the shot, in degrees.

maxElevationSwing.source: starting guess, owner to tune by feel
maxElevationSwing.why: Largest elevation change from start to end of the shot, in degrees.

distanceChange.source: starting guess, owner to tune by feel
distanceChange.why: Allowed (to minus from) over from for the camera distance.
